{"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["ST2334 prerequisite (MA1521) is completed, but CS3230 requires CS2040S/CS2040/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS which are not in the must-take list and have prerequisites (CS1010/CS1101S + CS1231/CS1231S) that are not satisfied by completed modules (CS1101S satisfies CS1010, CS1231S is completed, so CS2040S is eligible). However, CS2040S is not listed as 'must take'. Rule 8 forbids adding courses not asked for unless they are prerequisites for planned courses. CS3230 is a must-take course. Its prerequisite is (CS2040S or CS2040 or CS2040C or CS2040DE or CS2040HS) AND (CS1231 or CS1231S or MA1100T or MA1100). The student has CS1231S. But they do not have CS2040S or its equivalents. Therefore, a prerequisite course for CS3230 must be added. Rule 8 allows adding prerequisites. So CS2040S (or equivalent) must be added. CS2040S requires CS1010/CS1101S (CS1101S is completed) and CS1231/CS1231S (CS1231S is completed). So CS2040S is eligible. It must be taken before CS3230. CS3230 is a must-take. CS2101 requires CS3230. CS4246 requires CS3243 or CS3263. CS3243 requires CS2040/CS2040S... and CS1231/CS1231S. CS3263 requires CS2109S/CS2109HS and CS2040... and MA2001... and EE2012... etc. CS3243 is simpler. CS3243 requires CS2040S (or similar) and CS1231S. So CS2040S is also a prerequisite for CS3243. CS4246 is a must-take. So CS3243 or CS3263 must be added. CS3243 is offered Sem 2. CS3263 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. CS3263 has much harder prerequisites (MA2001, EE2012A etc). MA2001 is NOT open to BComp CS Hons. So CS3263 is likely not viable or requires other courses. CS3243 requires CS2040S and CS1231S. CS2040S is already needed for CS3230. So we add CS2040S and CS3243. CS2040S (4MC), CS3243 (4MC). CS3230 (4MC). CS2101 (4MC). CS4246 (4MC). CS2105 (4MC). CS2106 (4MC). ST2334 (4MC). MA1522 (4MC). CS2101 requires CS3230. CS3230 requires CS2040S. CS4246 requires CS3243. CS3243 requires CS2040S. ST2334 requires MA1521 (done). MA1522 is free. CS2105 requires CS2040/CS2040S... CS2106 requires CS2100/CS2100DE... CS2100 requires CS1010/CS1101S... CS1101S is done. So CS2100 is needed for CS2106. CS2100 is not in must-take. So CS2100 must be added. CS2100 (4MC). CS2106 (4MC). CS2105 (4MC). CS2105 requires CS2040/CS2040S... CS2040S is added. So CS2105 is eligible after CS2040S. CS2106 requires CS2100. CS2100 requires CS1101S (done). So CS2100 is eligible in Sem 2 (current). CS2106 is eligible after CS2100. CS2040S is eligible in Sem 2. CS3243 is eligible after CS2040S. CS3230 is eligible after CS2040S. CS2101 is eligible after CS3230. CS4246 is eligible after CS3243. ST2334 and MA1522 same semester. Current semester is 2 (Y1S2). Sem 5 is LOA. Sem 8 is last. Limit 16 MC. Must take: CS4246, ST2334, CS2105, CS2106, MA1522, CS3230, CS3219, CS2101. Added: CS2040S, CS3243, CS2100. Total 11 courses. 44 MC. Sem 2: CS2040S (4), CS2100 (4), ST2334 (4), MA1522 (4) = 16 MC. Sem 3: CS3243 (4), CS3230 (4), CS2105 (4), CS2106 (4) = 16 MC. Sem 4: CS3219 (4), CS2101 (4), CS4246 (4) = 12 MC. Sem 5: LOA. Sem 6: Empty? No, all must-takes done. Sem 7: Empty. Sem 8: Empty. Last semester used is 4. But student wants final semester lighter. Sem 4 has 12 MC. Sem 2,3 have 16. This is lighter. But wait, CS3219 requires YSC3232 or CS2103/CS2103T/CS2103DE/CS2113T/CS2113. None of these are in the plan. CS3219 is a must-take. Its prerequisite is not satisfied by CS3230. CS3230 is not a prerequisite for CS3219. CS2103 requires CS2030S/CS2030... and CS2040S/CS2040... CS2030 requires CS1010/CS1101S. CS1101S is done. So CS2030S is eligible. CS2030S is not in must-take. So CS2030S must be added for CS2103. Or CS2103T, CS2103DE, CS2113. CS2113 requires CS2040C/CS2040S/CS2040... CS2040S is added. So CS2113 is eligible after CS2040S. CS2113 (4MC). CS2113 is a prerequisite for CS3219. So we can take CS2113 instead of CS2103. CS2113 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. CS2040S is taken in Sem 2. So CS2113 can be taken in Sem 3. CS3219 requires CS2113. So CS3219 can be taken in Sem 4. This works. So added courses: CS2040S, CS3243, CS2100, CS2113. Total 12 courses. Sem 2: CS2040S, CS2100, ST2334, MA1522 (16 MC). Sem 3: CS3243, CS3230, CS2105, CS2106, CS2113 (20 MC). Exceeds 16 MC limit. Cannot fit. Try moving CS2105 or CS2106 to Sem 4. Sem 4: CS3219, CS2101, CS4246, CS2105, CS2106 (20 MC). Exceeds 16 MC. Try moving CS3230 to Sem 4? CS3230 requires CS2040S (Sem 2). So Sem 3 or later. If Sem 3 has CS3243, CS2113, CS3230 (12 MC). Then Sem 4 has CS3219, CS2101, CS4246, CS2105, CS2106 (20 MC). Still too heavy. Move CS2105/CS2106 to Sem 6? Sem 5 is LOA. Sem 6: CS2105, CS2106 (8 MC). Sem 4: CS3219, CS2101, CS4246 (12 MC). Sem 3: CS3243, CS3230, CS2113 (12 MC). Sem 2: CS2040S, CS2100, ST2334, MA1522 (16 MC). This fits. Sem 2: 16. Sem 3: 12. Sem 4: 12. Sem 6: 8. Sem 5: LOA. Sem 7,8: Empty. Last semester used is 6. Student wants fewest semesters. Can we do it in 4? Sem 2,3,4,6? No, Sem 5 is LOA. So Sem 2,3,4,6 is 4 semesters of study. But Sem 6 is Y3S2. Sem 4 is Y2S2. Sem 3 is Y2S1. Sem 2 is Y1S2. This is 4 semesters. Is it possible to finish in Sem 4? No, because CS2105/CS2106 depend on CS2040S/CS2100 which are in Sem 2. CS3219/CS2101/CS4246 depend on CS3230/CS3243 which depend on CS2040S. CS3230/CS3243 can be in Sem 3. CS3219/CS2101/CS4246 can be in Sem 4. But CS2105/CS2106 also need to be in Sem 4? CS2105 requires CS2040S (Sem 2). CS2106 requires CS2100 (Sem 2). So they can be in Sem 3 or 4. If we put CS2105/CS2106 in Sem 3, Sem 3 has 5 courses (20 MC). Too heavy. If we put them in Sem 4, Sem 4 has 5 courses (20 MC). Too heavy. So we must spread to Sem 6. So minimum last semester is 6. But wait, can we take CS2100 in Sem 3? CS2100 requires CS1101S (done). So CS2100 can be in Sem 3. Then Sem 2: CS2040S, ST2334, MA1522 (12 MC). Sem 3: CS2100, CS3243, CS3230, CS2113, CS2105, CS2106 (24 MC). Too heavy. Sem 2: CS2040S, ST2334, MA1522, CS2100 (16 MC). Sem 3: CS3243, CS3230, CS2113, CS2105 (16 MC). Sem 4: CS3219, CS2101, CS4246, CS2106 (16 MC). This fits! Sem 2: 16. Sem 3: 16. Sem 4: 16. Sem 5: LOA. Sem 6: Empty. Last semester used is 4. This is better than 6. So plan: Sem 2: CS2040S, CS2100, ST2334, MA1522. Sem 3: CS3243, CS3230, CS2113, CS2105. Sem 4: CS3219, CS2101, CS4246, CS2106. Check prerequisites: CS2040S: CS1101S (done), CS1231S (done). OK. CS2100: CS1101S (done). OK. ST2334: MA1521 (done). OK. MA1522: None. OK. CS3243: CS2040S (Sem 2), CS1231S (done). OK. CS3230: CS2040S (Sem 2), CS1231S (done). OK. CS2113: CS2040S (Sem 2). OK. CS2105: CS2040S (Sem 2). OK. CS3219: CS2113 (Sem 3). OK. CS2101: CS3230 (Sem 3). OK. CS4246: CS3243 (Sem 3). OK. CS2106: CS2100 (Sem 2). OK. All must-takes covered. Added courses: CS2040S, CS2100, CS2113, CS3243. All necessary. MC per semester: 16, 16, 16. Limit 16. OK. LOA in Sem 5. OK. Final semester (Sem 4) is 16 MC. Sem 2,3 are 16 MC. Not lighter. Student wants final semester lighter. Can we move a course from Sem 4 to Sem 6? Sem 6 is after LOA. CS2106 can be in Sem 6? CS2106 requires CS2100 (Sem 2). OK. CS2105 can be in Sem 6? CS2105 requires CS2040S (Sem 2). OK. CS4246 can be in Sem 6? CS4246 requires CS3243 (Sem 3). OK. CS2101 can be in Sem 6? CS2101 requires CS3230 (Sem 3). OK. CS3219 can be in Sem 6? CS3219 requires CS2113 (Sem 3). OK. If we move CS2106 to Sem 6, Sem 4 has 12 MC. Sem 6 has 4 MC. Sem 4 is lighter than Sem 2,3. But Sem 6 is the last semester used. Is Sem 6 lighter than Sem 4? 4 MC vs 12 MC. Yes. But student wants "final semester to be lighter than the others". If last semester is 4 MC, and others are 16, 16, 12, 4. Then 4 is lighter than 16 and 12. This satisfies the wish. But does it satisfy "fewest semesters"? Last semester used is 6. Previous plan was 4. Fewer semesters is better. Rule 1: "If the student wants to graduate as early as possible: the smallest last semester used." Student said "Please use the fewest semesters." This implies minimizing the last semester used. So Sem 4 is better than Sem 6. The wish for lighter final semester is a soft wish (Rule 3). We cannot trade a better step 1 (Sem 4 vs Sem 6) for more soft wishes. So we must choose Sem 4. In Sem 4, the load is 16 MC. Sem 2,3 are 16 MC. So the final semester is not lighter. But we cannot extend to Sem 6 to make it lighter because that increases the last semester used. So the plan with last semester 4 is the correct one. The soft wish for lighter final semester is not met, but step 1 takes precedence. Wait, "fewest semesters" might mean fewest semesters of study, not last semester number. But "graduate as early as possible" is defined as smallest last semester used. "Fewest total credits" is smallest total MC. Student said "use the fewest semesters". This is ambiguous. But usually means earliest graduation. So Sem 4. If it means fewest semesters of study, Sem 4 has 3 semesters of study. Sem 6 has 4 semesters of study. So Sem 4 is still better. So the plan is Sem 2,3,4. Final semester is Sem 4 with 16 MC. Not lighter. But this is the optimal plan under the rules.

Wait, check CS2101 prerequisite. CS2101 has no prerequisite. But student said "I need to finish CS3230 before I start CS2101". This is a constraint from the student, not a course prerequisite. So CS2101 must be after CS3230. In my plan, CS3230 is Sem 3, CS2101 is Sem 4. OK.

Check CS4246 prerequisite. CS4246 requires CS3243 or CS3263. I used CS3243. CS3243 is Sem 3. CS4246 is Sem 4. OK.

Check ST2334 and MA1522 same semester. Sem 2. OK.

Check CS3230 and CS4246 apart. Sem 3 and Sem 4. They are adjacent. "Apart" usually means not in the same semester or not adjacent? "Keep apart" is vague. But soft wish.

Check CS4246 as early as possible. Sem 4 is the earliest possible because it requires CS3243 which requires CS2040S (Sem 2). So Sem 3 is earliest for CS3243. Sem 4 is earliest for CS4246. OK.

Check CS2101 as early as possible. Requires CS3230 (Sem 3). So Sem 4 is earliest. OK.

Check CS2105 as late as possible. Can be Sem 3 or 4 or 6. In Sem 3. If we move to Sem 4, Sem 4 becomes 20 MC. Not allowed. If we move to Sem 6, last semester becomes 6. Worse for step 1. So Sem 3 is best.

So the plan is Sem 2,3,4.

One detail: CS2100 is added. CS2040S is added. CS2113 is added. CS3243 is added.

Are there any other constraints? "I need to finish ST2334 before I start CS3230". ST2334 is Sem 2. CS3230 is Sem 3. OK.

Final check on MC:
Sem 2: CS2040S (4) + CS2100 (4) + ST2334 (4) + MA1522 (4) = 16.
Sem 3: CS3243 (4) + CS3230 (4) + CS2113 (4) + CS2105 (4) = 16.
Sem 4: CS3219 (4) + CS2101 (4) + CS4246 (4) + CS2106 (4) = 16.

All good.
